attempts.outcome: V7-R design defect established; V7-R2 (48 × 2.25e6, α 0.005) selected by the measured rule (383/400, 384/400); route options I/II/III and items 1–8 prepared

reason_autonomous_resolution_not_possibl: EXPERIMENT.md §5 experiment-boundary: the frozen plan (validation/plans/v3-005d-elastic-attribution.md §5) authorises a model-change decision only for an "established" attribution, while its §4 says M2 is adopted "if §5 attributes H2"; the result is "partially attributed" with H2 named, so the two texts conflict and the record is not read as an authorisation (decision 0041, section 2026-10-17; Amendment 19 addendum (d)). Adopting M2 on a partial attribution, changing the (a)6 merge-gate set (Options I/II), carrying V10-A/V7-R as recorded failures with V7-R2 in V7-R's slot, taking one fresh V5 base after Amendment 17 (b)4 fired, and spending ≈ 37 host hours are boundary decisions the orchestrator may not make. All failures (V5, V11, V10-A, V7-R, V6/V6-sens, lv5b V5/V7, P6 below 12.53 MeV, MF6 copy rule) stay recorded; no tolerance, verdict or seed is changed by this request. Default without an answer: no model change, no re-qualification, PR #82 stays open.
